name_note: GTDB writes the epithet as mitsuoka, while the literature and the genomes in this taxon use Catenibacterium mitsuokai.

sentences.text: The genus Catenibacterium was proposed with the single species Catenibacterium mitsuokai for six Eubacterium-like strains from human faeces.
A metagenomic survey reported an unknown clade within Catenibacterium mitsuokai to be significantly more prevalent in non-urbanized populations than in urbanized ones.
Another study reported that the absence or abundance of Catenibacterium mitsuokai was involved in body weight family associations.
